methodology_source_html:
Source

Every listing is extracted from the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation (TDLR) public license registry (published open-licensed copy at data.texas.gov, dataset “TDLR – All Licenses”), pulled on {as_of}. The dataset covers {rows} rows; we keep licenses of these classes:
methodology_inclusion_extra_html: • Solo masters/journeymen with a business address are included; individual licenses without any business address are excluded from city listings (~{dropped_no_city} licenses — the registry is still the verification source of record).
ordering_html:
• License class held: contractor-level businesses, then master electricians, then journeymen.
  • Number of active licenses held at that address.
  • Telephone number on file (contactable businesses first).
  • Alphabetical by name — deterministic.
